Maria Duarte: Heads-up — noticed a weird oscillation in KV residency after we enabled per-tenant credits. Small tenants are growing memory steadily and then thrashing with paging/evictions. pprof shows repeated hot spots. attaching quick dump.

Maria Duarte: ```pprof --text kv_heap 30s
  60.0s  30.0% runtime.mallocgc
  40.0s  20.0% kv.(*Residency).Pin
  30.0s  15.0% kv.evictPagesLocked
  20.0s  10.0% kernel.selectOptimizedPath
``` 

Mike Li: I saw the same on s-gpu-12 last night. evict pulses ~45s, looks periodic :thinking:

Tara Nguyen: Can you paste kvstats for one of the noisy tenants? curious about resident_pages and lease_hits

Maria Duarte: ```
tenant: small-startup-42
resident_pages: 12k
lease_allocs: 1.2k
evict_ops_last_5m: 180
page_faults_last_5m: 430
avg_residency_bytes: 24MB
``` 

Girish Patel: Hypothesis: credit-refill window aligns with longctx eviction watermark, plus the new eager-pin kernel path (r4567) keeps pages pinned longer on refills. synchronous refills -> synchronized evictions. We should either jitter refill or add a transient soft-cap to avoid synchronized pulses.

Ciaran O'Connor: Did this correlate with the kernel selector change? good catch. Any perf regression numbers?

Maria Duarte: Correlated in time with kernel selector change + batching heuristics tweak on 2026-03-08. p99 latency for small tenants spiked from 62ms -> 120ms at the tail.

Olivia Park: Quick experiments: we tried a per-tenant max_residency cap (soft, not hard) in staging and saw p99 tail drop back ~30ms but throughput down ~2% for heavy tenants (expected).

Mike Li: Could try jittered refill + conservative cap only for tenants that hit eviction_rate_threshold. Less impact on heavy tenants.

Tara Nguyen: Proposal: run A/B: group A = jittered refill (0..+20% window) + monitor; group B = jitter + soft cap on tenants with evict_rate > X. Roll for 48h. Collect tenant-residency-evict-rate, kv-page-faults, p99-latency, tokens/s.

Maria Duarte: Sounds good. I'll create experiment and schedule on 3 nodes across 3 racks to avoid placement bias. @Ciaran can you add dashboards and alert rules?

Ciaran O'Connor: Yep — adding graphs: tenant_residency_percentile(95), tenant_evict_rate, kv_page_faults, longctx_memory_growth. Will add alert if eviction_rate doubles baseline.

deploy-bot: experiment created: exp-20260315-kv-credit-jitter (targets: staging:kvpool-1, canary set: 10% of tenants)

Maria Duarte: Thanks. I'll follow up with early results in #eng-runtime tomorrow :thumbsup:
